<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear isotopic series spaced by ~1.003 Da with relative intensities that match the expected 13C pattern for ~13 carbons. No other characteristic isotope spacings (e.g., ~2 Da for Cl/Br) are present, so the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotopic distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
